card.name: Words just before lab and dosing thresholds
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before a number or limit in lab and kidney or liver criteria, such as the 'ir' inside bilirubin after 'total', 'renal' before impairment, or a gap before a time value. Also some linking words before a named reaction or exposure.
